design: 2x2 entry-filter ablation; original exits and risk sizing unchanged
ranking_schedule: Sunday completed close selects candidates for Monday through Sunday executions
ranking_universe: Current study whitelist, only peers meeting original own risk-on signal and positive volume on snapshot day
trend_only: Own completed signal-day close strictly above own MA150
existing_holdings: Retained until original exits; rank downgrade alone never forces an exit; active positions can exceed 2
allocation: Original per-pair capital/profit budgets and full universe slot count; no redistribution of unspent budgets
baseline_reuse: Five matched core3 windows if source/data match, fresh baseline for all other windows
diagnostic: Classify original positions by last completed own close/MA150 before initial entry; attribute whole trade cashflows and terminal MTM, including partial fills
limitations: AVAX is listed before 2021 but lacks MA150 warmup until early 2021, equally for every strategy
SUI is included only in broad8 windows after 150-day maturity
More cash may explain lower drawdown; ranking does not redistribute budgets
Profit attribution is descriptive; removing a trade changes later sizing and entry paths

follow_up.reason: Separate entry screening from concentrating actual available capital after observing idle cash
follow_up.decision_timing: Added after first core3 and broad7 screening results; retrospective follow-up
follow_up.budget: Starting account capital plus all closed profits plus partial realized open profits, divided by 2; unrealized profits excluded
follow_up.existing_holdings: Original exits; no forced weekly rotation
follow_up.parameter_changes: None: same 60-day top2 Sunday ranking, no new signal threshold
